body:
**Mondo term (ID and Label):**
MONDO:0009106 diastematomyelia

**Xref that should be fixed (ID and label):**
[Orphanet:1671](http://www.orpha.net/ORDO/Orphanet_1671)  Split cord malformation type I
This is too narrow for this concept. Would recommend instead using Split cord malformation ORPHA:573278 .  Per SNOMED CT 445308004, split cord malformation and diastematomyelia are synonyms.

SCM type 1 and 2 are narrower subtypes that may or may not be in scope for Mondo.
